title: 第3章 圣塔白晶牛第4章 效果如何
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
被鬼影匪团劫掠过的部落比比皆是，平原上一些靠种植的小部落每年收成时期，都要花费大量的物资去寻求天元部落的庇护才能安全度过。
不过剩下的却也只能勉强过冬，根本留不出什么富余。
导致人们只要听到鬼影匪团的名号，在恐慌万状的逃窜下又不由对其恨之入骨。
“小子们跟老子绕到正门，见什么抢什么，动静越大越好！”
彭左看着身后二十余壹纹战士狞笑道。
随即对着旁边的一个身材矮小的头目低道：“火虫，别忘了你的任务。”
“好的头儿！”
天生侏儒的火虫却是一名壹纹战士。
血兽魔鬼豺的血纹使得他在黑夜中有着极强隐秘能力。
说罢胸口泛起的红光转瞬消失，整个人瞬间如黑夜融为一体，只剩一双细小的眼睛在黑夜中显得冷厉骇人。
眨眼功夫人影便消失不见。
“走！”
彭左看罢大手一挥，快步向前。
不多时还没等彭左他们到正门，便听到头顶石质围墙上传来苍老的声音。
“鬼影匪团怎么光临我们这种穷乡僻壤？我们这儿可没有好酒好菜招待。”
彭左抬头，却见到一位老者站立在墙头，虽然这老者看起来浑身没有多少肉，干瘦得像晒干的三角羊。
但那一对深陷的眼睛格外明亮，仿佛有着无穷的精神力。
此人正是连师。
话音未落，又听到不远处传来一声野兽般地暗吼，声音未逝，又一提刀魁梧男子跃上墙头，剑眉怒目，黝黑的方脸上被气血环绕，在诡异的血纹加持下，身体内部的野兽嘶吼仿佛要把眼前一切碾碎。
彭左暗暗皱眉，双眼幽光宛转心道：“该死，这么快便感知到我等行踪，连尼这老家伙难道……”

心底迟疑片刻，面上却大笑道。
“哈哈哈，岩蒙，老头，多年不见嘛，来找老朋友叙叙旧，哎呦……怎么不见岩勒啊，老子现在还忘不掉他那一夫当关的雄姿呢。”
彭左嘴角一勾，皮笑肉不笑道。
岩蒙听罢，提刀的手上青筋复现，他双眼像一团熊熊烈火，滚烫的怒火同气血一起喷涌而出。
旁边的连师也是双手握拳，浑身止不住的颤动。
“少废话！
彭左！
速速离去，否则我岩蒙今晚定要让你们有来无回！”
岩蒙竖刀低声怒道。
彭左也收起张狂，低下头面露凶光，疤痕下的眼睛死死盯着墙上的二人。
眉心处血光浮现，顷刻间向四周蔓延，形成血纹，抽出背上大刀。
护心葵水蛙的血纹中，隐隐有着一抹黑光，使彭左的气息直达肆纹战士。
阴沉道：“就你们想教我彭左做事！”
说罢，双脚一蹬，纵身飞跃，挥刀向岩蒙劈去。
“杀！”
身后的马匪都一一抽出武器，显现血纹，不同的血纹在漆黑的夜晚格外明亮，有几个马匪的血纹中更是同样有这彭左那般的黑光流动。
岩蒙气血浮动，朝着彭左挥出一刀，随着刀光闪现，隐隐伴随着一头身长五米左右的青白身形蹦出，虽不得具体，但能看出来是一头双角狰狞的血兽白牛。
content_en:
There are many tribes that have been plundered by the ghost bandits. Some small tribes on the plains that rely on planting spend a lot of materials to seek shelter from the Tianyuan tribe every year during the harvest period in order to survive safely.
But the rest can only survive the winter, leaving no surplus at all.
As a result, as long as people hear the name of the Ghost Bandits, they can't help but hate them as they run away in panic.
"The boys and I go around to the main entrance and grab whatever we see. The louder the noise, the better!"
Peng Zuo looked at the more than twenty One-pattern warriors behind him and said with a ferocious smile.
Then he whispered to a short leader next to him: "Fireworm, don't forget your mission."
"Okay boss!"
Firefly, who was born a dwarf, is a Yiwei warrior.
The blood pattern of the Blood Beast Devil Jackal gives him a strong stealth ability in the dark night.
After saying that, the red light on his chest disappeared in an instant, and his whole body melted into one body like the night, leaving only a pair of tiny eyes that looked cold and terrifying in the dark night.
The figure disappeared in the blink of an eye.
"Let's go!"
After looking at it, Peng Zuo waved his big hand and walked forward quickly.
Not long after, before Peng Zuo and the others reached the main entrance, they heard an old voice coming from the stone wall above their heads.
"Why do the ghost bandits come to a remote place like ours? We don't have good wine and food here."
Peng Zuo looked up and saw an old man standing on the wall. Although the old man didn't seem to have much meat on his body, he was as skinny as a dried triangle sheep.
But the pair of deep-set eyes are particularly bright, as if they have infinite spiritual power.
This person is the company commander.
Before he finished speaking, he heard a beast-like roar from not far away. Before the sound faded away, another burly man jumped onto the wall with a sword in hand. His sword eyebrows were glaring, and his dark square face was surrounded by blood. Under the blessing of strange blood lines, the roar of the beast inside his body seemed to crush everything in front of him.
Peng Zuo frowned secretly, his eyes dimly gleamed and said to himself: "Damn it, you sensed our whereabouts so quickly, how could this old guy Lenny..."
He hesitated for a moment in his heart, but then laughed loudly on his face.
"Hahaha, Yan Meng, old man, I haven't seen you for many years. I came here to catch up with my old friend. Ouch... Why don't you see Yan Le? I still can't forget his majestic appearance of one man taking care of the other."
Peng Zuo curled up the corner of his mouth and said with a soft smile.
After Yan Meng heard this, the veins on the hand holding the knife reappeared, and his eyes were like a blazing fire, with hot anger and blood spurting out.
The company commander next to him also clenched his hands into fists and his whole body was shaking uncontrollably.
"Cut the nonsense!
Peng Zuo!
Leave quickly, otherwise I, Yanmeng, will make it impossible for you to come back tonight! "
Yanmeng Shudao said angrily in a low voice.
Peng Zuo also put aside his arrogance, lowered his head with a fierce look on his face, and stared at the two people on the wall with his scarred eyes.
Blood appeared in the center of his eyebrows, spreading to all sides in an instant, forming blood lines, and he pulled out the big knife on his back.
There was a faint black light in the blood pattern of the Heart-protecting Sunflower Water Frog, which caused Peng Zuo's aura to reach directly to the Si Wen warrior.
He said gloomily: "You are the only ones who want to teach me Peng Zuo how to do things!"
After saying that, he kicked off his feet, leaped forward, and slashed at Yanmeng with his sword.
"Kill!"
The horse bandits behind them all drew their weapons one by one, revealing blood lines. Different blood lines were particularly bright in the dark night, and the blood lines of several horse bandits also had the same black light flowing like Peng Zuo's.
Yanmeng's energy and blood were floating, and he swung a knife towards Peng Zuo. As the light of the knife flashed, a green and white figure about five meters in length jumped out. Although it was not specific, it could be seen that it was a blood beast white bull with two ferocious horns.
